title: Rest completion omits stableRecoveries from benefits payload and persisted evidence
description:
Post-merge review of PR #457 (verified against current main, 2026-07-19).

## Defect

Rest completion hides automatic stable recoveries from its evidence. In `complete()` (`packages/core/src/state/rest.ts:588-611`), `advanceWorldTime` returns `time.stableRecoveries`, but the constructed `benefits` object copies `expiredEffects`, `previousElapsedMinutes`, `elapsedMinutes`, `inGameTime`, `narrativeLabelStale`, and `closedRecoveryWindows` from `time` while omitting `stableRecoveries`. That object is both the tool response and the persisted `benefits_json` (rest.ts:684-688).

Gameplay consequence: a short rest can wake a stable character (recovery deadline falls inside the rest's elapsed window → `adjustHp(+1)` → conscious at 1 HP) while the model and the turn auditor receive no evidence of the HP/life-state transition. Their pre-tool context still says the character is stable at 0 HP — a direct narration/audit blind spot, and the persisted rest record is incomplete for later history traversal.

## Required fix (per review)

Add `stableRecoveries: time.stableRecoveries` to the benefits payload; test both the returned tool value and the persisted `benefits_json` for a rest whose window crosses a stable-recovery deadline.

Coordinate with the advanceWorldTime atomicity bead (same review) — moving recovery resolution inside the clock transaction changes where `stableRecoveries` comes from, so these two are best fixed in one PR.

Related (same PR #457 review): Demon Armor permanent doff block, migration-0020 stranded stable characters, advanceWorldTime recovery atomicity.
